Add character-aware profiles for variables, views, action sets, highlights, and layouts; introduce UUID-based multi-sidebar placement with a Bench and responsive collapse behavior; reorganize settings into a searchable, scope-aware menu; add a managed Script Manager with Restricted and Trusted Lua sandboxes and safe one-click updates; add per-rule desktop, browser, and Discord notifications; and extend PraetorScript with live `my.*` values while improving command feedback and mobile-sized layouts.
